scope: Symbols identify documented antecedents of the named method or option, not identical complete configurations or claims of priority.

arms.label: Legacy EPA, ring
arms.basis: Inherited GP EPA and ring-placement baseline; FeeBL has corrected the Born normalization.

arms.label: Finite-mass EPA, ring
arms.basis: FeeBL finite-mass refinement; no complete-configuration equivalence asserted.

arms.label: Finite-mass EPA, profile
arms.basis: This profile is not identified with the full CAIN nonlocal construction. Nonlocal sampling itself already exists in CAIN.

arms.label: Full QED, ring
arms.basis: FeeBL hard-process extension; inherited ring placement does not make the full treatment a GP configuration.

arms.label: Full QED, profile
arms.basis: FeeBL hard-process extension with a separately qualified spatial prescription.

arms.label: EPA, electron-mass cutoff
arms.basis: GP Table V electron-mass cutoff control and CAIN electron-mass transverse-momentum scale; cutoff definitions and spatial sampling are not identical.

arms.label: EPA, no beam-size suppression
arms.basis: GP/CAIN no-beam-size control in Table III; CAIN LOCAL option.

arms.label: Full QED, no beam-size suppression
arms.basis: Symbols apply only to disabling beam-size suppression, not to the full-QED hard-process treatment.

arms.label: Full QED, expanded domain
arms.basis: Numerical domain control, not a claim of a new physical prescription.

rimbault2006.locations: Incoherent-pair modelling discussion and Tables II, III and V

cain244.locations: Version 2.44 (2017), section 3.12 pp. 46-47 and sections 5.11.2-5.11.3 pp. 123-125
